summary: ApplyRefund reverses the whole FX fee on every refund. Prorate the reversal with the existing Prorate(c.FXFeeMinor, refundMinor, c.AmountMinor) helper (integer arithmetic, half-even rounding); a full refund still reverses the whole fee. One line in internal/ledger/ledger.go.

steps.title: Prorate the FX fee reversal in ApplyRefund with Prorate(c.FXFeeMinor, refundMinor, c.AmountMinor)
steps.rationale: The helper already implements half-even integer proration; no float64 for money.

steps.title: Run go vet and the unit tests
steps.rationale: TestApplyRefund/partial_eur_fx_fee and partial_half_even cover the bug; full_eur_fx_fee guards the full-refund case.

acceptance_criteria.text: A partial refund of EUR 40.00 on a EUR 100.00 charge with a EUR 0.48 FX fee posts fx_fee_reversal EUR -0.19.
A full refund still reverses the whole FX fee.
go vet ./..., go build ./... and go test ./... pass.

risks: Half-even rounding: repeated partial refunds can differ by one minor unit in total from the original fee.
